product_overview: Fresher.AI is a career-preparation platform that helps authenticated users build and upload resumes, receive AI-based resume scoring, follow a personalized learning roadmap, and practice interviews. The app also provides a public landing page and authenticated navigation to key preparation tools.
core_goals: Explore the product and access sign-in from the public homepage
Upload a resume and view parsed resume details
Review AI-generated resume scores and improvement recommendations
Follow a personalized roadmap for skill development
Start interview sessions, answer questions, and review interview feedback
Navigate an authenticated dashboard to reach the main preparation tools

features.name: Homepage and navigation
features.description: The public landing page introduces the platform and provides access to authentication entry points and marketing content.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the landing page content -> Review the platform sections -> Open the login modal -> Close the login modal
Navigate to / -> View the landing page content -> Review the platform sections -> Start the free onboarding entry point -> Open the login modal

features.name: Login and registration
features.description: Users authenticate through Firebase Google sign-in from the login modal to access protected areas of the app.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the login modal -> Choose Google sign-in -> Complete authentication -> See the app continue into the authenticated experience
Navigate to / -> Open the login modal -> Choose Google sign-in -> Cancel the sign-in attempt -> Remain on the homepage with the login modal dismissed or unchanged

features.name: Authentication and route protection
features.description: The app checks for an existing session and keeps protected pages inaccessible until the user is signed in.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard while logged out -> See the app redirect to / -> Access the homepage instead of the protected page
Navigate to /resume while logged out -> See the app redirect to / -> Access the homepage instead of the protected page
Navigate to /roadmap while logged out -> See the app redirect to / -> Access the homepage instead of the protected page
Navigate to /scorer while logged out -> See the app redirect to / -> Access the homepage instead of the protected page
Navigate to /interview while logged out -> See the app redirect to / -> Access the homepage instead of the protected page

features.name: Resume upload and parsing
features.description: Authenticated users can upload a supported resume file and see extracted resume data displayed in the builder.
user_flows: Navigate to /resume -> Open the resume builder -> Select a supported resume file -> Submit the upload -> See parsing progress -> See parsed resume data displayed
Navigate to /resume -> Open the resume builder -> Select an invalid file type -> Attempt to submit the upload -> See validation feedback and stay on the builder

features.name: AI resume analysis
features.description: Authenticated users can request resume analysis and view a score with AI-generated recommendations.
user_flows: Navigate to /scorer -> Request analysis -> See loading progress -> See the resume score and recommendations displayed
Navigate to /scorer -> Request analysis -> Wait for analysis to fail due to invalid user input or unavailable data -> See the error state surfaced on the page without leaving the scorer

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Authenticated users can review an overview of their resume, interview, and progress information and use it to reach other tools.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View summary stats and overview content -> Use the navigation controls to open resume, roadmap, scorer, interview, and pricing areas
Navigate to /dashboard -> Sign out -> Attempt to continue using the authenticated area -> See access removed and protected navigation no longer available

features.name: Roadmap
features.description: Authenticated users can open a personalized roadmap and review generated learning guidance.
user_flows: Navigate to /roadmap -> Load the roadmap data -> See generated roadmap content displayed
Navigate to /roadmap -> Load the roadmap data -> Wait for an unsuccessful load caused by missing user input or unavailable data -> See the failure state on the roadmap page

features.name: Interview functionality
features.description: Authenticated users can configure an interview, start a session, answer questions, and review the resulting report.
user_flows: Navigate to /interview -> Select interview options -> Start the interview -> Enter the active interview session -> Submit an answer -> Continue through the session
Navigate to /interview -> Select interview options -> Start the interview -> Exit the interview session -> Return to the interview setup flow
Navigate to /interview -> Select interview options -> Start the interview -> Complete the session -> Open the interview report -> Review the feedback and report summary

known_limitations.issue: Authentication UI provides Google sign-in only; email/password registration is not present
known_limitations.impact: Registration coverage depends on Firebase popup behavior and cannot validate email/password registration

known_limitations.issue: Frontend API base URL is hard-coded to localhost:8000
known_limitations.impact: API tests require the backend gateway to be available on port 8000
End-to-end API flows may fail if gateway and services are not separately running
